title: Vendor & Tooling for Risk/Incident Response
transcript:
Procurement: The procurement process for that forensic tool could take weeks, and we're already running behind on the privacy complaint deadline.

Engineering Manager: I agree. We can't afford to delay the response, even if it means compromising on a full investigation.

Security Reviewer: But what about having a dedicated incident response team? We'd be better prepared for situations like these.

Engineering Manager: I understand your concern, but given the urgency, we don't have the luxury of time for a time-consuming recruitment process.

Budget Owner: If we outsource the entire investigation to an external vendor, the costs will be astronomical. Plus, the timeline uncertainty could jeopardize compliance.

Security Reviewer: And hiring an in-house team isn't viable either, given the short notice.

Engineering Manager: Given these constraints, I propose we implement a partial response with immediate action, while initiating a full investigation concurrently.

Budget Owner: Agreed, as long as we can keep the costs in check.

Security Reviewer: I suppose it's better than nothing, but I still have reservations about our readiness for future incidents.

Procurement: I'll look into providing supplemental tools to help the team handle the immediate response.

Engineering Manager: If the internal investigation reveals complications beyond our expertise, we can bring in third-party forensic consultants.

Security Reviewer: Alright, but I'll continue to advocate for long-term planning.

(Off-topic exchange)

Engineering Manager: Have you seen that new game from the marketing department? It looks fantastic!

Procurement: Yeah, I've been wanting to play it! Let's see if we can squeeze in some time after this meeting.

(Returning to the topic)

Budget Owner: Alright, let's get started. I'll sign off on the decision.

Engineering Manager: Great. I'll oversee the implementation and manage any potential risks.

Budget Owner: Let's hope this approach works out. The last thing we need is more headaches.

Title: Response to Data Privacy Complaint - Decision Log

The Engineering Manager will oversee the immediate response to the data privacy complaint, utilizing supplemental tools provided to the current staff. An expensive forensic tool will be procured to ensure a prompt investigation, avoiding potential delays that could jeopardize the compliance deadline. Concurrently, a full investigation will be initiated.
